 Chitwan Rhinos to bat first against Kathmandu Gorkhas 
 Nepal News 
 November 18, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Chitwan Rhinos have decided to bat first against Kathmandu Gorkhas in the eliminator match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) on Wednesday. The toss took place at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, with the match scheduled to begin at 5 p.m.
 The winner of this eliminator will advance to face Sudurpaschim Royals in the second qualifier. The victor of that match will then compete against Lumbini Lions for the championship title. The losing team in today’s match will be eliminated from the tournament, making the contest critical for both sides.
 Historically, the two teams have faced each other three times in the NPL. Kathmandu Gorkhas have secured two victories, while Chitwan Rhinos have won once. Previously, Chitwan reached the play-offs in the first edition of the tournament, while Kathmandu achieved the feat in the second edition.
